# Sailor's bounty

Type: Feast | Internal ID: FeastOceans_Material | Source: Food preparation table | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Cooked fish x5, Thistle x4, Cooked serpent meat x2, Seafarer's herbs x1 | Max Health: 45 | Max Stamina: 45 | Duration: 50m | Healing: 3 hp/tick

# Introduction

Sailor's bounty is the Ocean-tier Feast.

## Recipe

Sailor's bounty can be produced at a Food preparation table with:
• Cooked fish x5
• Thistle x4
• Cooked serpent meat x2
• Seafarer's herbs x1

Categorias: Food, Feast
